gn161_diop_presence.note: Astra edition review (revision 1.164): this publisher biography retrospectively compresses the federal-platform titles. OCLC 5736086 gives the cultural/technical/industrial original under [1960]; BnF FRBNF35182688 gives the economic/cultural revised title in 1974. The earlier witness is retained, but it must not identify the later title as the 1960 original. No whole-book reading is added.
